fields.title: Keep SQL static, consolidated, and segregated from application binaries
fields.decision: Use static, parameterized SQL that is consolidated and kept separate from application binaries; discourage dynamic SQL generated from C# object models.
fields.context: Application code coupled to table and column implementation inhibits database changes and makes queries difficult to understand and improve as data changes.

alternatives.option: Generate dynamic SQL from a C# object model or compile SQL into application binaries.
alternatives.whyRejected: It adds SQL compilation and injection risks, obscures SQL for optimization, and tightly couples application code to database implementation details.

fields.consequences: Parameters and returned results remain the query contract while database implementation can be rewritten, partitioned, hinted, or otherwise optimized without breaking consumers; SQL experts can work on data-domain changes independently.
